simple.meaning: מִקְשָׁה (miqshâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering ( repoussé ).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 25:18. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִקְשָׁה (H4749) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מִקְשָׁה (miqshâh) / H4749 is traced through Exodus 25:18, Exodus 25:31, Exodus 25:36, Exodus 37:7 with generated occurrence evidence.

structuredEvidence.definition: rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering ( repoussé )

firstOccurrence.englishText: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.

timeline.evidenceText: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.
“You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.
Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.
He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:
He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.
Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.
This was the workmanship of the lamp stand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work. He made the lamp stand according to the pattern which Yahweh had shown Moses.

definitions.short: rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering ( repoussé )
definitions.usage: beaten (out of one piece, work), upright, whole piece.
definitions.full: H4749. miqshah II. מִקְשָׁה noun feminine perhaps hammered work , only of metals (originally turner's work ?); — absolute ׳מ , of cherubim in tabernacle Exod 25:18 ; 37:7 , lampstand 25:31 , 36 ; 37:17 , 22 ; Num 8:4 (twice in verse), clarions 10:2 . — I. ׳מֹ see קשׁא .
